## This repository is not accepting pull requests right now

GitEasy is maintained by a single author and currently does **not** accept
outside contributions. There is no contributor license agreement (CLA) in
place; pull requests will not be reviewed or merged at this time.

**Found a bug?** Please open an Issue instead — those are welcome and
read regularly.

**Have a feature idea?** Open an Issue describing the use case. No code
needed. The author will consider it.

If/when this project opens up to outside contributions, this template
will be updated with the contribution workflow.

Thanks for your interest in GitEasy.
